seo.title: Free human help for everyday digital problems
seo.description: Stuck with a website, device, or confusing account? Get clear, step-by-step help from a real human developer. No jargon, no chatbots.
seo.keywords: free digital help, real tech support, simple internet help, human customer service, website problems

title: Stuck online? Let's fix it in plain English.
subtitle: Modern technology is full of confusing screens and automated chatbots that go nowhere. If something digital is getting in your way, send me the problem.
freeNote: This service is 100% free. No hidden fees, no subscriptions.

sections.whatItIsBody: Every day, things change online without warning. Buttons move, accounts get locked, and error messages make no sense. I am a web developer offering a simple, real-human help desk. No automated systems, no jargon—just a real person helping you figure out what went wrong.
sections.whatToSendTitle: How to help me solve your problem
sections.whatToSendBody: I am not an all-knowing wizard, and I cannot see your screen. To give you the right answer, I need context. Tell me: What exact device are you using? What website or app is giving you trouble? What were you trying to do, and what happened instead?
sections.howItWorksBody: You fill out one short form. I read the requests from my personal inbox daily. If I know the answer, I will email you simple, step-by-step instructions. If I need a little more context to understand the glitch, I will reply asking one clear follow-up question.
sections.responseTitle: When you can expect a reply
sections.responseBody: I try to reply within 1 to 2 days. Because this is a real human checking real emails—not an instant automated chatbot—it might take a little longer if the problem requires deep research.
sections.limitsBody: I cannot fix physically broken hardware, recover stolen passwords without your recovery info, or provide instant live chat. This is also not a place for sales spam. Please send one genuine digital problem at a time.
sections.examplesTitle: How to write a great request
examples: Instead of 'My phone freezes', write: 'My phone freezes every time I try to attach a photo to an email.'
Instead of 'I can't log in', write: 'I am trying to log into my utility account on my laptop, but it keeps looping back to the home page.'
Instead of 'The website is broken', write: 'I am trying to fill out a government form, but the Send button stays gray and won't let me click it.'
